body.summary: walkNode credits calls made at module load (program-level statements including every test() body, program-level and exported declarations' non-function values, export default values) to the file entity, one CALLS per callee per file. The file-level scan skips every subtree that gets an entity of its own (function and class declarations and function-valued declarators, at any depth), so calls inside them, including ones declared in a top-level block or a test callback, keep only their own caller. Nine mutations each fail the tests.
